TABLE.NAME: tool_imagepicker_original
TABLE.COMMENT: Preserved original images which back the cropped images of image picker fields.

FIELD.NAME: contextid
FIELD.COMMENT: The context id where the original file is stored. This is always the context of the file area which the image backed by this original lives in.

FIELD.NAME: component
FIELD.COMMENT: The component of the file area which the image backed by this original lives in. This is the draft area (user/draft) as long as the image has not been saved anywhere yet.

FIELD.NAME: filearea
FIELD.COMMENT: The file area which the image backed by this original lives in. This is the draft area (user/draft) as long as the image has not been saved anywhere yet.

FIELD.NAME: itemid
FIELD.COMMENT: The item id of the file area which the image backed by this original lives in. This is the draft item id as long as the image has not been saved anywhere yet.

FIELD.NAME: derivedhash
FIELD.COMMENT: The content hash of the currently displayed (cropped) file which this original backs.

FIELD.NAME: cropx
FIELD.COMMENT: The x position of the last crop region, as a fraction (0..1) of the original image width.

FIELD.NAME: cropy
FIELD.COMMENT: The y position of the last crop region, as a fraction (0..1) of the original image height.

FIELD.NAME: cropwidth
FIELD.COMMENT: The width of the last crop region, as a fraction (0..1) of the original image width.

FIELD.NAME: cropheight
FIELD.COMMENT: The height of the last crop region, as a fraction (0..1) of the original image height.
